user.title: Set up shopping list
user.description: Almost done! Set the cleanup day and time later right in the card: ⚙️ → Cleanup.

data_description.sidebar: Adds a "Einkaufsliste" entry to the sidebar (full-page view). Off by default.

init.title: Shopping list – options
init.description: Cleanup (on/off, day, time) is now set right in the card: ⚙️ → Cleanup.

data_description.reset_pin: Tick if the PIN for the gear in the card was forgotten. The gear is then open without a PIN again.
data_description.sidebar: Adds a "Einkaufsliste" entry to the sidebar (full-page view). Off by default.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item. If it is on the list and checked, it gets unchecked.

create_missing.name: Create missing
create_missing.description: On = a store or category that does not exist yet is created. Off (default) = error, so a typo does not create a new store.

get_items.name: Get items
get_items.description: Reads the shopping list (changes nothing) and returns it as a response – for automations, Assist and AI.

status.name: Which items
status.description: open = still to buy, checked = checked off, history = everything ever bought (with count).

store.name: Store
store.description: Only items of this store (empty = all).

update_item.name: Update item
update_item.description: Changes an item on the list. Only the given fields change, the item keeps its place.

name.name: Name
name.description: Which item (as it is on the list).

store.name: Store
store.description: Only look in this store (if the item exists more than once).

new_store.name: New store
new_store.description: Move to this store (empty text = anywhere).

add_store.name: Add store
add_store.description: Creates a new store. If the name already exists, nothing happens.

add_category.name: Add category
add_category.description: Creates a new category. If the name already exists, nothing happens.

add_recipe.name: Add recipe
add_recipe.description: Puts all ingredients of a recipe on the list.

cleanup.name: Cleanup
cleanup.description: Checks all open items that are old enough. Nothing is deleted.

angebote_melden.name: Report offers
angebote_melden.description: Send your own offers (e.g. from AppDaemon or a REST request) to the list. The card shows them like the Marktguru offers with 🏷️ at the matching item. Nothing is sent to the internet.

offers.name: Offers
offers.description: List of entries: name (required, item name), price (required), store, title, regular_price, valid_from, valid_until, description, currency (e.g. CHF), url (https link to the product page), country (e.g. CH, the offer's country).

source.name: Source
source.description: Name of your source (e.g. denner). With “Replace” on, only the old offers of this source are replaced.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: On = old offers of this source are dropped. Off = add. Empty list + on = clear the source.

country.name: Country
country.description: Optional: country of all offers in this call (e.g. CH). Order: country on the offer → this field → currency (CHF = Switzerland). Offers with a country only show at items whose store is in that country (or that have no store yet).
